extractions.unit: It is acceptable if the infant's eyes, particularly a newborn's, are partially or completely closed

scope_quotes: Infants pose a particular challenge.
context_quotes: The goal is the best likeness that can reasonably be obtained
unit_attributes.action: accept photograph with infant's eyes partially or completely closed
unit_attributes.summary: In infant passport photographs, it is acceptable if the infant's eyes (particularly a newborn's) are partially or completely closed.

extractions.unit: The infant's head may be discreetly supported, e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child

scope_quotes: Infants pose a particular challenge.
context_quotes: e.g., a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child
unit_attributes.summary: An infant's head may be discreetly supported (for example, using a car seat with a white or off-white blanket behind the child).

extractions.unit: A parent’s face cannot be in the photograph of the infant

scope_quotes: Infants pose a particular challenge.
unit_attributes.action: be in the photograph of the infant
unit_attributes.summary: A parent's face must not appear in the infant's photograph.

extractions.unit: You must request a new photograph if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:

scope_quotes: if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements:
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the photograph submitted does not meet the specified requirements.
unit_attributes.logic_text: if the photograph submitted does not meet the following requirements
unit_attributes.summary: Adjudication personnel must request a new photograph if the submitted photograph does not meet the specified requirements.

extractions.unit: The photograph must be in color

unit_attributes.summary: The passport photograph must be in color.

extractions.unit: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of and satisfactorily identify the applicant at the time of the application

unit_attributes.logic_text: within six months of submitting the application AND be a good likeness of AND satisfactorily identify the applicant
unit_attributes.action: be taken within six months of application submission, be a good likeness of, and satisfactorily identify the applicant
unit_attributes.summary: The photograph should be taken within six months of submitting the application, be a good likeness of the applicant, and satisfactorily identify the applicant at application time.

extractions.unit: The photograph must be free of material damage

unit_attributes.summary: The photograph must be free of material damage.

extractions.unit: Material damage is any damage to the facial area that makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant (e.g., creases, large holes, and large smudges) or impedes the functioning of facial recognition (damage in the area of the eyes)

unit_attributes.choice_text: damage to the facial area that makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant or impedes the functioning of facial recognition
unit_attributes.logic_text: makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant OR impedes the functioning of facial recognition
unit_attributes.summary: Material damage means any damage to the facial area that makes the photograph no longer a good likeness of the applicant or impedes the functioning of facial recognition.

extractions.unit: Immaterial damage is any damage to the background, and non-material damage to the facial area (e.g., staple holes)

unit_attributes.logic_text: damage to the background AND non-material damage to the facial area
unit_attributes.summary: Immaterial damage is defined as any damage to the background and non-material damage to the facial area (such as staple holes).
